authorization:
사용자 원문: 그래 한 50개 만들고 전부 통과시켜
신규50종의 기술/독립 시각 검수 통과를 위해 지적 좌표를 실제로 교정하고, 이후 사용자 위임으로 Allow한다. 검수 결과를 꾸미지 않고 기존 판정을 보존한다.

issues.message: At the tool-arm root, torso skin at x53-54 is separated from the forearm skin beginning at x57 by the two dark outline pixels x55-56. Below this joint, the background gap makes the diagonal forearm look detached. Redraw the elbow/upper-arm connection around x54-59, y75-79 with a continuous several-pixel red skin cluster; keep outline on the exterior and preserve the connected hand/lantern.

The same outline-only elbow connection remains in this frame. Join upper-arm skin to the diagonal tool forearm around x54-59, y75-79, with an explicit elbow bend consistent with repaired sleep_a; do not rely on touching black outlines to establish anatomy.

The exposed red ankle/foot starts at x74-75 near y86, while the lantern ends at x70 and background occupies x71-72 through y89. Only the dark ground-row bridge around y91 connects the foot to the rest of the silhouette, so it reads as a loose foot. Draw a visible brown trouser/red calf bridge behind the lantern into the heel around x70-75, y85-90, retaining exterior outline and floor contact.

The yellow vest trim present in sleep_a is replaced by blue highlight pixels around x43-44, y75-77, breaking the trim for this frame while the head and seated silhouette remain essentially fixed. Restore the continuous trim. If breathing is intended, reshape a small connected chest/shoulder cluster consistently between the pair instead of flickering the seam color.

The flame is genuinely attached to the lantern through the bright cluster on y50, but the handle opening above stays unchanged and the jet appears to pierce the upper-right paper shell. Define a readable emission opening near x73-77, y48-52 and run the bright flame root continuously through it into the existing rightward branches; preserve the actual hand/handle connection.
